primary_endpoint: Percent change from baseline in whole-liver PDFF at Day 42.
efficacy_outcome: At Day 42, PDFF changed by 8.14% with placebo, −40.01% with PF-05221304, −30.14% with PF-06865571, and −40.13% with the combination. The three active-arm comparisons with placebo had p-values of 0.0000, 0.0007, and 0.0000, respectively.
safety_signal: Serious adverse events: placebo 0/14, PF-05221304 0/29, PF-06865571 0/28, and combination 1/28; no deaths in any arm.
